full_page.content:
Page 49 Sept. 2 Thanks - Fred Kinchular - 17 - given up in Ann arbor Hosp. as never to walk again from infantile paralysis From July 1941 to Jan '42 ... ....... Has been working all summer ... now figuering on going back to school.
Sharon S. Fournier - 4 yesterday, bright little girl - deaf was en- rolled sometime ago and since that has been saying some words ....
3rd Baby Dan M. Mortier - Bn. last Saturday - Very serious obstruction in Chest. So far only nourishment received has been through tube incerted in stomach ...... Enrolled Today perpetually.
Nicholas Bender - 26 - Greek Orthodox Parents - Mother widow. .. gives his wages to someone else - divorced woman. .... goes to church once in yr.
Betty O'Hanley - 14 - Parkhill, Ont. - brain tuomer - Drs fear oper- ation will deprive her of sight and speech .... Enrolled 50c ... promises perpetual enrollment and more frequent Communion if ....
Gladys Delanney - 43 - non c. - very serious kidney trouble.
Page 50 Sep. 7 Leo Grolimund - 23 - in St. Elizabeth Hospital, Washington D.C. - seri- ous mental trouble if not hopeless. Enlisted in Marines last January. Enrolled To-day 1.00 Mother promising.
John Burns - 52 - very serious-electric shock (in Fords) at work - now in St. Joseph's Retreat ....
Robert McCarty - 28 - Married non cath. She now
Dara Bohlinge - 51 - asks for prayers that she may be able to walk and keep her home together.
9 Mary McIvors - 24 - mental trouble - seemingly healthy otherwise and to external physics openness, intelligent but four year has refused to speak.
11 Sophia Mankowski - 39 - Breast Cancer removed. Dr. Hopes to save breast.
1943, March
1943 Page 51 Mar. 11 Charles A. Kelly - 44 - triconosis - has family, wife and son - de- pending.
Mrs. E. Sebert - 34 - mother of two little girls .... fighting against drink - Husband.
